chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
When replies are numerous, the correct point remains obscure.

key_terms.ازْدَحَمَ: to be crowded, numerous, or crowded together
key_terms.خَفِيَ: to become hidden, obscure, or unclear

ai.seo_question: What does Imam Ali mean when he says 'When replies are numerous, the correct point remains obscure'?
ai.summary: In the context of Nahj al-Balagha, this maxim warns against the rhetorical trap of verbosity, where an accumulation of answers dilutes the core truth, a concept deeply resonant with Shia emphasis on *bayan* (clear exposition) over *ta'wil* (obscure interpretation). It serves as a practical guideline for scholars and leaders to prioritize precision and conciseness in discourse to prevent the confusion of the audience. This principle aligns with the broader ethical framework of *adab al-kalam* (etiquette of speech) found in Shia hadith literature.
